description: This file defines the ConfigFileAPI class, which extends an upgrader API for handling configuration file updates during installation in the OrangeHRM system. It manages database info setup and handles encryption key creation, integrating with the system's state management.

classes.name: ConfigFileAPI
classes.description: API controller class for handling configuration file operations during installation, including database info handling and encryption key setup.

methods.name: handlePost
methods.description: Handles POST requests, manages database info setup, possibly writes encryption keys, and returns error responses if needed.

methods.name: getRegistrationType
methods.description: Returns a constant indicating the registration type for installer startup.
